title: Cottage Poems

authorInfo.bio: Patrick Brontë (1777–1861) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Cottage Poems" by Patrick Brontë is a collection of verse written during the Victorian era. This poetic work reflects on themes of rural life, spirituality, and the human condition, emphasizing the beauty and simplicity found in nature and among humble folk.
